question: Welcher Aufgabenbereich hat seinen Anteil von 10,2% im inneren Kreis auf 7,8% im äußeren Kreis reduziert?
question_english: Which task area reduced its share from 10.2% in the inner ring to 7.8% in the outer ring?
model_answer:
Here’s an answer to your question about the figure:

The Sport & Erholung (sports and recreation) sector shows a reduction in its percentage from 10.2% in the inner circle to 7.8% in the outer circle between 2014 and 2021. This represents a decrease of almost 2.4 percentage points in the popularity of this activity during that period.
